div.div: بَزِيلٌ , applied to wine or beverage, i. q. ↓ مُبْتَزَلٌ [which may mean either That whereof the containing vessel has been broached and which has been drawn forth, or that which is cleared or clarified; but more probably the former]. (Ibn- 'Abbád.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
